50520440.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to EZH2 (unknown origin) expressed in baculovirus infected SF9 cells co-expressing SUZ12/EED/RbAp48 complex by ITC analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Determination of Compound Off-Rates and Residence Times. PRC2 4-complex (0.4 mg/mL; EZH2, SUZ12, EED, RbAp48) was incubated with 0.4 μM compound in 100 mM Tris (pH 8.5), 4 mM DTT for 20 min. Measurement of compound dissociation was initiated by addition of a 100-fold excess of a competing compound to prevent rebinding. At the indicated time points, dissociated compound was separated from enzyme-bound compound by transferring the mixture to a pre-equilibrated 0.5 mL Zeba desalting column (7 kDa MWCO). Eluents containing the PRC2–compound complex were transferred into a 96-well plate, where 1% formic acid was added to aid in the analysis by mass spectrometry. Excess compound 32 was used to compete off compound 31 and compound 1, while excess 31 was used to compete off 32. To determine 100% occupancy, a sample was taken prior to addition of the competitor compound, and 0% occupancy was determined by addition of the excess competitor compound prior to the compound of interest followed by transfer to the desalting column. Compound quantification was carried out using a RapidFire 350 high-throughput solid-phase extraction chromatography system coupled to an Agilent 6550 quadrupole time-of-flight (Q-TOF) mass spectrometer. The reaction mixture (42 μL) was injected onto an Agilent Graphite type D cartridge in 0.1% TFA and eluted in 80% acetonitrile and 0.1% TFA. The RapidFire settings were as follows: aspiration time = 600 ms (or until the loop was full as detected via a sip sensor), load time = 3000 ms, elution time = 6000 ms, re-equilibration time = 500 ms, flow rates = 1.5 mL/min for pump A, 1.25 mL/min for pump B, and 1.25 mL/min for pump C. After elution, samples were analyzed on an Agilent 6550 Q-TOF mass spectrometer with an Agilent Jet Stream source with ion funnel technology set in positive-ion mode. Mass spectrometry settings were as follows: gas temperature = 225 °C, drying gas = 17 psi, nebulizer, sheath gas temperature = 250 °C, sheath gas flow rate = 9 L/min, capillary voltage = 3500 V, nozzle voltage = 1000 V, fragmentor = 350 V, skimmer = 65 V, OCT 1 RF Vpp = 750 V. Peaks were analyzed in RapidFire Integrator software by extracting ion chromatograms for the compounds using the following m/z values: 446.1033 for compound 31, 527.3129 for compound 1, and 412.1422 for compound 32. Integrated peak data were then converted into percent occupancies using the 100% and 0% occupancy standards. Finally, the percent occupancy data were fit to a one-phase exponential decay equation [Y = (Y0 − plateau) × exp(−kx) + plateau] using Prism 6 (GraphPad Software). The value of k approximates the koff value, and the residence time was calculated as 1/k.
